info.name: Fence OpenAPI Specification admin/user export API

params.name: program
params.description: The program to which the submitter belongs and in which the entities will be created. The `program` is the human-readable name, e.g. TCGA.

params.name: project
params.description: The project to which the submitter belongs and in which the entities will be created. The `project` is the human-readable code, e.g. BRCA.

params.name: ids
params.description: one or a list of node IDs seperated by commas.

params.name: node_label
params.description: type of nodes to look up, for example ``'case'``

params.name: format
params.description: output format, ``json`` or ``tsv`` or ``csv``; default is ``tsv``

params.name: with_children
params.description: whether to recursively find children or not; default is False

params.name: category
params.description: category of node to filter on children. Example: ``clinical``

params.name: without_id
params.description: whether to include the ids in the export file; default is False

items.docs: Return a file with the requested entities as an attachment. Either ``ids`` or ``node_label`` must be provided in the parameters. When both are provided, ``node_label`` is ignored and ``ids`` is used. If ``ids`` is provided, all entities matching given ``ids`` will be exported. If there is only one entity type in the output, it will return a ``{node_type}.tsv`` or ``{node_type}.json`` file, e.g.: ``aliquot.tsv``. If there are multiple entity types, it returns ``gdc_export_{one_time_sha}.tar.gz``
